utterances.speaker: Ammar Nasim
utterances.text: Let's start with the Line 3 backlog. We closed the week at 42,000 pairs against a plan of 55,000.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: The gap is almost entirely the nitrile dip line. We lost eleven hours to the curing oven fault on Tuesday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: OEE for the week: 61.4% on Line 3 vs 78% target. Downtime pareto attached in the channel.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: Maintenance replaced the thermocouple Thursday morning. It has run clean since, but we have not requalified the oven profile.

utterances.speaker: Lena Fischer
utterances.text: From the customer side, the Aldi order for week 36 is the exposed one. They will not accept a split shipment this time.

utterances.speaker: Lena Fischer
utterances.text: Aldi PO 88213 - 18,000 pairs, must ship complete by 4 Sept.

utterances.speaker: Ammar Nasim
utterances.text: Then we protect Aldi first. Priya, can Line 5 take the overflow if we move the industrial glove run out a week?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Line 5 can take about 9,000 pairs of it. Beyond that we run into the liner supply, we only have stock through the ninth.

utterances.speaker: Ammar Nasim
utterances.text: Alright, decision: we move the industrial glove run to week 37 and put 9,000 pairs of the Aldi order on Line 5. Lena, confirm the ship date with the customer today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Noted. I'll re-cut the schedule and share the revised plan by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: I will get the oven requalification done Saturday during the planned stop, so we are not guessing on Monday.

utterances.speaker: Lena Fischer
utterances.text: One open point - if liner supply slips again in September, do we hold or partial-ship? We never settled that policy.

utterances.speaker: Ammar Nasim
utterances.text: Leave that with me, I'll take it to the commercial review on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Tom Becker
utterances.text: Risk to flag: the second oven on Line 3 is on the same thermocouple batch. If it goes, we lose the line entirely.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Agreed, I'd rather change both now than wait for the second one to fail.

utterances.speaker: Ammar Nasim
utterances.text: Tom - raise a CRO for the second thermocouple this week please.

utterances.speaker: Ammar Nasim
utterances.text: Same time next week. Priya's revised plan and Tom's requalification result are the two things I want to see.
